description: While the initiatives deservedly get a lot of attention, the Washington State Supreme Court races are the most consequential decisions on this year's ballot. Five of the nine seats are up for election. That is over half of a court that has repeatedly ignored the will of the people and the actual text of Washington's Constitution.
